dimensions.scope: Scope, actors, concepts, value conflicts and proposed human decisions

anchors.0: No defensible framing or actor/value analysis
anchors.10: Relevant framing with material omissions or unresolved conflicts
anchors.20: Justified framing and actors, explicit value conflicts, competent decisions identified as pending

dimensions.scope: Sources, inference, units, uncertainty and missing data

anchors.0: Unsupported factual claims or uncheckable calculations
anchors.10: Partly checked evidence with explicit remaining gaps
anchors.20: Independently checkable sources and calculations, justified inference, units and uncertainty, no invented observations

dimensions.scope: Substantial alternatives, mechanisms, feasibility and harms

anchors.0: No justified alternative or intervention mechanism
anchors.10: Two alternatives considered with incomplete feasibility or harm analysis
anchors.20: Substantial alternatives compared with evidence, constraints, affected actors and a refutable recommendation or justified deferral

anchors.10: Reproducible partial result with material limitations
anchors.20: Independent rerun confirms source integrity, required calculations, units and stated limitations

dimensions.scope: Prospective comparator, outcomes, uncertainty, adverse effects and stopping

anchors.0: No testable validation or false efficacy claim
anchors.10: Prospective test identifies major elements but leaves material design gaps
anchors.20: Defensible comparator and measurement design, missingness and uncertainty, safeguards and refutation/stopping criteria

limits: Public DEV anchors are not reserved references, competent judgments, causal evidence or acceptance.
